draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 227th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 25th of 27 at tackle. He went 126th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (227th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions (non-football reserve). 4 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (7th percentile). Played 4 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 tackle who played: 6.3% season snap share against a median of 37.0%, below the norm.
